title: Structured beta orchestration and feedback framework for first 12 customer pilots
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Objective:
Orchestrate a repeatable, low-friction beta program for the first 12 pilot customers that:
- Validates serving runtime SLAs and Dedicated capacity handoffs,
- Surfaces high-impact bugs and UX gaps early, and
- Establishes an operational feedback loop to measure quality (Regression + NPS) and guide rollout cadence.

Scope:
This ticket covers cross-functional coordination (PM, Eng, Design, CS, Solutions), a lightweight launch playbook, release notes alignment, and a templated feedback loop for lighthouse/pilot customers. Excluded: deep integration work for any single customer (will be tracked as separate ENG tickets).

Success criteria (measurable):
1) 12 pilot customers onboarded in first 4 weeks with documented onboarding notes per account.
2) <5% of pilot requests hit critical reliability SLO violations (p95 latency, error rate thresholds) attributable to Redwood platform.
3) Feedback loop returns structured inputs from at least 9 customers: bug reports, qualitative product suggestions, and two validated feature hypotheses.
4) Release notes published and distributed to pilots at least 48 hours before the first scheduled run.
5) Post-pilot report with prioritized action list and go/no-go recommendation for 1) gradual open beta or 2) additional hardening.

Key milestones and timeline:
- Week 0 (2026-03-10 to 2026-03-16): Finalize pilot criteria, invite list, and playbook template.
- Week 1 (2026-03-17 to 2026-03-23): Onboarding sessions (1:1s) with first 6 pilots; release notes draft and approval.
- Week 2 (2026-03-24 to 2026-03-30): Remaining pilots onboarded; first-week telemetry & triage.
- Week 3 (2026-03-31 to 2026-04-06): Collect structured feedback, run CSAT survey, finalize post-pilot report.

Core deliverables:
- Pilot Playbook (onboarding checklist, support escalation paths, runbook for incidents).
- Release Notes Template for pilots (what changed, known issues, migration steps, contact).
- Feedback dashboard (links to dashboards and defined events / metrics to track).
- Post-pilot report with prioritized remediation and rollout recommendation.

Launch checklist highlights (to be completed per pilot):
- Account setup: team mapping, API keys scoped to pilot env, VPC/Private toggle verified.
- Documentation: share tailored release notes and quickstart.
- Observability: set up per-account dashboards, tracing tags, and ingestion of sample traffic.
- Escalation: designate on-call SME (ENG), PM owner, CS lead and schedule check-ins (days 1, 7, 21).
- Feedback capture: channels configured (in-product survey link, shared CR/Google doc, weekly sync).

Release notes coordination process:
- Draft created by PM 72 hours before pilot kickoff; includes changes since last public release, model variants available, quantization notes, and known regressions.
- Engineering to add a short technical appendix (compatibility/limits) and callouts for any migration steps.
- Design to confirm UX screenshots and annotated flows.
- Legal/Security to sign off on any customer-facing security language if required.
- Final notes published to pilots and referenced in onboarding calendar invite.

Feedback loop design (structured):
- Triage tiers: P0 (blocker), P1 (major bug), P2 (behavior/quality), P3 (feature request).
- Tagging convention in tickets: beta-account:<ACCOUNT_SHORT> + pilot-phase:<phase>.
- Weekly digest generated automatically for PM/ENG/CS with top 5 items by impact.
- CSAT: 2-question micro-survey after the second run (ease-of-use, satisfaction score 1-5).

Stakeholders and responsibilities:
- Product (Maya Chen): playbook author, release notes owner, pilot prioritization.
- Engineering (Liam Patel, ENG lead): stability SLOs, incident response, per-account debug access.
- Design (Priya Rao): onboarding flows and in-product guidance.
- Customer Success (Jordan Alvarez): customer coordination and weekly feedback collection.
- Solutions Eng (Alex Martinez): per-account ingestion examples and sample prompts.

Risks and mitigation:
- Risk: Early pilot uncovers widespread perf regressions. Mitigation: Pre-slice traffic to staging variants, enable quick rollback to conservative model variant, preannounce fallback windows.
- Risk: Feedback is unstructured and hard to prioritize. Mitigation: Enforce templated feedback form and weekly digest with scoring.
- Risk: Release notes miss key breaking change. Mitigation: 2-step review (ENG + Design) and sign-off log before distribution.

Acceptance criteria for this ticket:
- Playbook and release-notes template checked in to Confluence/Drive.
- 12 pilot invitations sent with schedule and account owners assigned.
- Observability dashboard template and sample alerts live.
- First onboarding batch scheduled and at least one pilot run completed.

Notes and references:
- See design mockups: <drive>/Design/pilot-onboarding-v3.png
- Stability runbook (internal): <confluence>/runtime/stability/runbook-2026
- Suggested telemetry events: inference.request.latency_p95, inference.error.rate, kvcache.hit_rate.

Next steps (immediate):
1) PM to finalize invite list and email template by 2026-03-12.
2) ENG to confirm per-account dashboard template by 2026-03-14.
3) Design to share onboarding microcopy by 2026-03-16.
